msContents.summary: Greek-Sahidic Coptic bilingual of the Gospels.

projectDesc.p: This transcription was made by Dr. Hans Förster and colleagues towards the Editio Critica Maior of John between 2010 and 2015.

editorialDecl.p: The initial transcription file was a plain text file for use with COLLATE, later converted to XML.
The plain text file was converted to XML by Hugh Houghton and Catherine Smith using the project's Python conversion scripts in 2023.
The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at

revisionDesc.change: Robert Turnbull added the verse numbers of John 6:21-58, which were labelled John.4.21-58; the manuscript's GA, TM, summary, date for the BICROSS Navigator.
